verdict.rationale: Open WebUI's RAG feature is well documented as letting users attach documents/sources for grounded chat answers (docs-15, docs-28, docs-40), but independent hands-on reports state RAG 'never worked' for them without a GPU even with external APIs configured, suggesting real friction in typical self-hosted deployments (comm-3, comm-4). Missing for 10: independent corroboration that RAG reliably works out-of-the-box across common (non-GPU) setups, and clearer documentation addressing this failure mode.
